# External scores

Scores in this folder come from openly licensed sources and may be redistributed.
They are copied into `data/raw/` by `scripts/build_corpus.py`.

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chopin-op28-4.musicxml` | Converted from the LilyPond engraving of Chopin's Preludes Op. 28 by Knute Snortum ([github.com/ksnortum/chopin-opus-28](https://github.com/ksnortum/chopin-opus-28), commit `9c0e38a`) with a one-off script; checked measure by measure. Pitches only: dynamics, slurs and ties were dropped. | CC BY-SA 4.0 – credit: Knute Snortum. Changes to this file must keep the same license. |
| `chopin-op28-4.pdf` | Page 6 of the Preludes Op. 28 edition by Knute Snortum (IMSLP #800939, LilyPond 2.22.2, 2022). | CC BY-SA 4.0 – credit: Knute Snortum. |
